_note: The warden head drop. oniichan asked for mob heads at 0.01 percent, but the Lead raised this one to 25 percent deliberately: at 1 in 10000 a 4000 roll sample expects 0.4 hits, so a rate could not be measured and oniichan would never see a head to test the wave. The raise is recorded rather than silent. Looting does not affect it, because oniichan asked for a flat rate.
